name: Improved Combat Expertise (Combat)
body:
You know how to remain an effective attacker while building up your defense.

Prerequisite: Int 13, Combat Expertise, base attack bonus +8

Benefit: When you use Combat Expertise, reduce the number you subtract from melee attack rolls and combat maneuvers by 2.
